verdict.rationale: Any public website can publish an llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so this axis applies. Probes found no llms.txt (404), no markdown doc variants (404) and no OpenAPI spec at any candidate path. The keyless Socrata JSON dataset on data.texas.gov is a machine-readable data feed on a host platform, not agent-oriented documentation, so it earns no credit here.
